text.p: French shares fell in late morning from an all-time high above 3,000 as a wave of profit-taking swept over European stock markets.
"It's happening all over Europe right now. London has broken 5,000, Wall Street 8,000 and we 3,000. There is profit-taking in a relatively quiet market," a broker said.
* CAC-40 index down 12.86, or 0.43 percent, at 2,975.15 at 0920 GMT. All-time high at 3,006.54.
* CAC-40 July futures 2,983 vs 2,999 at Wednesdays close.
* Volume 2.7 billion francs of which 2.1 billion in CAC-40 shares.
